scope: Independent read-only initial-load source review. No tests or fixture changes run by reviewer.
findings: Confirmed initial loading lacked explicit Close and failure lacked Retry.
Shared error helper disables retry immediately; old dialog closes before replacement is opened with all six original arguments.
Initial success/error require connected/open ownership; queued old close cannot steal focus from new dialog.
Existing GET path,permissions and save behavior untouched; no blocking source issue found.
limit: Source review does not certify every profile control/native AT/all-role behavior.
